resources.string: Root-backed MCP server for on-device agents: confirmed shell execution, screen capture, input injection and dynamic code injection into scoped apps.

Lets 奈何桥 act on this device on your behalf: capture the screen, send taps and swipes, and read the current screen\'s controls. Everything it does also keeps the server running so an agent can reach it while another app is in front. Every action still asks you first.
